messages:
marta-peopleops: FYI hiring asks: Rafael (remote UK) needs an exception for comp-band and health start. Hiring wants band5 -> band6 uplift and benefits effective 2026-05-04 (candidate start). Payroll earliest enrollment 2026-05-18. Can we approve backdating and fast-track?

kevin-hiring: Candidate is a critical IC for infra infra-scaling sprint. Offer accepted verbally. Manager wants band6 to match counteroffer. Candidate's requested start is 2026-05-04 to hit project ramp.

noah-finance: Flags: UK payroll runs twice monthly. Retroactive pension/employer NI can be done but needs documented approvals and CFO sign-off. Cost delta for uplift roughly A38,200 annualized.

anita-talent: If benefits enrollment is delayed candidate might decline. We should consider a temporary employer-paid private health enrollment from day one while payroll processes pension. Is that allowed?

ravi-legal: Legally fine if covered with approval note and signed offer showing effective date. Recommend limiting retro to 14 days and documenting in HR file. Also need to confirm relocation stipend timing if any.

marta-peopleops: Proposed: approve provisional band6 pending CFO ok, allow benefits enrollment retro to start date up to 14 days, HR to add exception note and request payroll backdate. Approve?

noah-finance: Conditional OK. I'll prepare the cost memo and tag Maria-CFO. Need detail on relocation stipend, share numbers by EOD.

kevin-hiring: I'll attach signed offer as soon as Priya signs (priv link). Manager can push for CFO note.

anita-talent: I'll get the signed docs uploaded and notify legal. Also can enact temporary private health coverage via vendor starting 05/04 if HR approves.

ravi-legal: Please send scan of signed offer with effective 2026-05-04 to legal@redwood for audit trail. Approve the 14-day cap wording: "Benefits enrollment may be applied retroactively to candidate start date, not to exceed 14 calendar days; payroll adjustments handled by Finance."

hr-bot: Tasks created: "request-cfo-approval" -> @noah-finance, due 2026-04-30; "manual-health-coverage" -> @marta-peopleops, due 2026-05-04.

marta-peopleops: OK I'll hold uplift until CFO signs. Noah please ping Maria.

noah-finance: Maria, ping. Quick summary: uplift cost ~A38,200 annualized; backdate benefits up to 14 days; minimal one-time NI adj. Approve?

maria-cfo: (via DM) Reviewed. Approve band6 uplift and benefits retro up to 14 days. Finance to absorb one-time payroll adjustments.

noah-finance: CFO approved. Final: band6 uplift confirmed, retro benefits to 05/04 max 14 days, HR to issue corrected offer with effective date and legal to keep doc.

marta-peopleops: Issued updated PDF offer and enrollment note. Candidate signed at 11:12. HR-bot triggered manual health coverage and payroll backdate request. Closing thread and filing exception EXC-2026-058. :white_check_mark:
